newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from SubCulture Recordings' official demo, home, releases, events, podcast and legal-navigation pages. The label is accepting demos for 2027 and explicitly permits submissions from anywhere. It prefers a downloadable private SoundCloud playlist containing 6 to 10 tracks, titled Artist – Track Title (Demo/WIP), with downloads enabled. Finished tracks and works in progress are accepted; WAV is preferred and high-quality MP3 is also allowed. demos@subculture050.com is first-party published, syntactically valid, domain-aligned and explicitly designated for demos. The page also contains an embedded form, but its provider, complete fields, submit-time controls and consent were not passively exposed. Activity is confirmed by the current Physis: Deuterion Stasimon release, a June 26, 2026 release party, © 2026 and the weekly Mysteriae podcast. No form field, email, playlist or submission was sent.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from Pangea Recordings' official January 16, 2026 demo guide, contact, home, DJ Samer and 2026 editorial pages. The label accepts demos year-round for progressive house, melodic techno and deep techno, and its official artist page says artists and labels worldwide may submit. The guide identifies pangea@pangearecordings.com and recommends 1 to 3 tracks, a private SoundCloud or other streaming/download link, concise introduction and no unsolicited large attachment. It describes WAV or AIFF at 24-bit/44.1 or 48 kHz as professional preparation guidance rather than a mandatory email attachment. Pangea's 2026 guide says it is looking for music that is not AI-generated, so origin must be reviewed before contact. The mailbox is first-party published, syntactically valid, domain-aligned and expressly designated for demos. Activity is confirmed by the updated 2026 guide, April 2026 podcast episode 131 and May 2026 editorial updates. No email, link or submission was sent.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from Symmetry Recordings' official demo page and official Bandcamp catalog. The label publishes demos@symmetryrecordings.co.uk and asks for 320kbps MP3 or WAV versions attached to email or supplied through a storage/cloud link. Tracks must be labelled with producer and track name; SoundCloud links are accepted only when downloading is enabled. The label states that every submitted track is heard. Its official Bandcamp also links an alternative LabelWorx DemoBox at https://www.label-worx.com/demo/symmetry-recordings; the exact live fields, JavaScript requirements, upload limits, consent, CAPTCHA and login state were not passively inspected, so that route remains a manual boundary rather than an automated path. demos@symmetryrecordings.co.uk is first-party published, syntactically valid, domain-aligned and explicitly designated for demos. Current activity is confirmed by releases in January, March, May and June 2026, including SYMM074 – So Right on June 5, 2026. No email, attachment, link, upload or submission was sent.
